facts.subject: telegram-surfaces
facts.aliases: Bridge Telegram SPA Telegram два бота разница Bridge-бот SPA-бот телеграм пульт владельца продуктовый бот
facts.fact: Two Telegram bots by design. Bridge bot (com.studiobridge.telegram, repo studio_bridge) = Studio OS Owner Control Plane: Director report /report /needs /alerts /work /system /product, confirm-first text/voice intake through SPA's canonical seams. SPA bot (com.spa.telegram_bot) = product surface: portfolio, strategies, go-live, SPA alerts, SPA owner-decision cards. Neither moves capital.

facts.subject: financial-state-ownership
facts.aliases: кто владеет финансовым состоянием Studio OS инвестиционные движки граница финансовая правда где живёт финансовое состояние
facts.fact: Studio OS is the control plane (tasks, evidence, approvals, memory, releases) and never holds financial state. Investment engines (DeFi yield engine, Trading Research Engine, earn-defi) own signals, strategies, market data, positions, execution models and financial risk state.

facts.subject: trading-research-engine
facts.aliases: Trading Research Engine движок торговых исследований торговый движок откуда появился идея что реализовано что сделано
facts.fact: Origin: owner directive 2026-09-30 «CAPITAL ARCHITECTURE v1 + TRADING RESEARCH ENGINE v0» after an audit found SPA had no directional price-trading engine (ADR-525). Implemented: spa_core/trading_research — 138 BTC candidates (10 public-domain families × 1h/4h/1D × spot / 1× perp paper), closed-candle Binance data, backtest with IS/OOS/costs/regimes, ranking (5 qualified), append-only hash-chained FORWARD paper since 2026-09-30 21:23 UTC, agent com.spa.trading_research every 15 min, TRADING block in the Director report. No real execution.

facts.subject: owner-approval
facts.aliases: одобрение владельца что требует Юрия решай сам спроси меня owner approval owner gate что нельзя без владельца
facts.fact: Exactly three subjects stay with the owner (ADR-285): (1) real money movement — execution, keys, payments, going live; (2) public yield numbers, tier naming, legal wording; (3) irreversible actions — data deletion, external publication, external commitments. Plus actions the agent physically cannot do (sudo, creating repos). Everything else the agent decides and records in the journal.

facts.subject: fleet-acceptance-incident
facts.aliases: Fleet Acceptance инцидент восстановление приёмка флота канарейка что случилось
facts.fact: 2026-09-29 the trusted-bootstrap canary exited 2/CRITICAL; three of four findings were defects of the acceptance INSTRUMENT, not the fleet: the acceptance receipt was written into the immutable release, launcher exec model, fleet interpreter path. Fixed by ADR-516 (immutable release ≠ mutable operational state; single-source fleet_python); the phase was then accepted (approved release 4cb68535).

facts.subject: roadmap
facts.aliases: дорожная карта что дальше следующий эпик roadmap after Trading Research Engine план
facts.fact: Canonical roadmap docs/ROADMAP.md: 1 Memory & Context Architecture v1 (with MemPalace evaluation) → 2 DeFi Architecture Gap Audit → 3 DeFi Engine vNext → 4 Build Loop → 5 Owner Remote / Mission Control → 6 Capital Allocator / Portfolio CIO → 7 limited real-capital pilots → 8 later engines.

facts.subject: proposed-vs-implemented
facts.aliases: предложенная реализованная фича описанное отличие работающее proposed implemented feature L2 L4 зрелость
facts.fact: A proposed feature (idea, draft, design doc) is not an implemented one. Design docs carry a maturity level: L2 = document exists, no code; L3 = code but not really working; L4 = code + tests + data; L5 = live agent (.claude/rules/design-docs.md, docs/MATURITY_REGISTER.md). Memory statuses: PROPOSED ≠ ACCEPTED ≠ ACTIVE; an idea in docs/ideas is not an instruction until #promote.
